Title: Deep Song + Drawing out the Beast

Messages.Author: svensven
Messages.Body:
I guess I'm a little confused by Frenzy.

1) Does Deep Song frenzy MY attacking minion or THEIR "being attacked"
minion?
2) Can a vampire be under the effects of two frenzy cards?
3) Can you Deep Song at Superior and then Drawing out the Beast on the
minion you are attacking?

Matt

Drawing out the Beast:

Only usable before range is determined on the first round. Frenzy.
[ani] During this combat, opposing vampire gets +1 strength, but he or
she cannot use maneuvers to maneuver to long range, cannot use presses
to end combat and cannot use equipment. A vampire may play only one
Drawing Out the Beast each combat.
[ANI] As above, and the opposing vampire takes 1 unpreventable damage
during the press step each round.

Deep Song

[ani] (D) Bleed at +1 bleed.
[ANI] Frenzy. (D) Enter combat with and tap a ready vampire controlled
by another Methuselah. In that combat, that vampire is considered the
acting minion.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
On Sep 20, 11:37 am, svensven <ulf...@yahoo.com> wrote:
> I guess I'm a little confused by Frenzy.
>
> 1) Does Deep Song frenzy MY attacking minion or THEIR "being attacked"
> minion?

The latter. It frenzies the target-of-the-(D)-action minion.

> 2) Can a vampire be under the effects of two frenzy cards?

Yes.

> 3) Can you Deep Song at Superior and then Drawing out the Beast on the
> minion you are attacking?

Yes.
